About this item

FOLDING PORTABLE E-BIKE - Conveniently foldable electric bike measuring 39*39*28.7" when folded and weighing only 70 pounds. Adjustable seat and handlebars to suit individual preferences. Maximum load capacity of 330 pounds, ideal for commuting, errands, or leisurely rides.
1500W POWERFUL MOTOR - Ride with a 1500W (PEAK 2000W) brushless motor and Shimano 21-speed shifting system. The 7-speed system offers customizable speed options. Our electric scooter handles off-road and steep rocky terrain effortlessly.
REMOVABLE BATTERY - Ebikes for adults are equipped with 48V/20AH larger-capacity lithium batteries and longer lifetime, covering a range of 55-75 miles per full charge. Removable battery, convenient to bring home or office to recharge.
VERSATILE RIDING MODES - Our electric bike offers three working modes: bike mode, pedal assist mode, and pedal mode. Cruise effortlessly in bike mode, enjoy a boost in pedal assist mode, or get some exercise in pedal mode. Our bike caters to your preferred riding style and needs.
LOCKABLE SUSPENSION FORK - Our adult e-bikes feature a lockable front suspension fork, LCD, and LED light for a smoother and safer riding experience.
SAFE AND RELIABLE BRAKING - Enjoy peace of mind with a disc brake system and front/rear shock absorbers, ensuring reliable braking and comfortable rides in various conditions.
26" X 4" FAT TIRES - Conquer any terrain with our e-bike's puncture-proof fat tires. Ride confidently on snow-covered streets, sandy beaches, mountain trails, and urban environments. Explore the world with ease and style.
ONE-YEAR WARRANTY - Established in New Jersey and proudly serving the US since 2008. Our products come 90% pre-assembled and include a 2-year warranty on the motor, battery, and charger. For any inquiries, feel free to reach out, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours. //Please keep the original packaging for some time.

Product Description

Travel becomes freer and more enjoyable, while commuting becomes easier!

Our RIDSTAR Foldable Electric Bike is designed for urban commuters, outdoor adventurers, campers, and fitness enthusiasts who want a versatile and powerful bike that can handle any terrain and weather condition.

With its compact and foldable frame, you can easily store it in your SUV trunk, office, or apartment, and take it with you on trains, buses, or elevators.

RIDSTAR 26'' x4.0'' 2000W Folding Electric Bikes for Adults

Battery
48V/20AH (Waterproof & Removable & With Phone Charge Port)

Gears
Front Derailleur Shamano 3-Speed + Rear Derailleur Shamano 7-Speed(3*7=21)

Riding Options
Pure Electric, Pedal Assist, and Pedal Modes

Max. Slope
30°

Max. Range
55 miles in pure electric mode, 75 miles in pedal assist mode

48V 20AH BATTERY
The detachable battery design of 48V20Ah enhances convenience during charging, allowing for easier recharging. It enables the electric bike to achieve a range of 55-75 miles on a single charge.

SMART LCD METER
The waterproof LCD interface provides information on battery power, speed mode, and accumulated mileage in a compact format.

DUAL SUSPENSION EBIKE
Dual-suspension e-bikes offer improved comfort, control, and maneuverability with front and rear suspension systems. They absorb impacts, enhance traction, and provide a smoother ride on rough terrains.

26''x 4.0'' FAT TIRES
26''x 4.0'' Fat tires effectively absorb shocks and bumps, optimize weight distribution, and minimize the risk of skidding, ensuring a smooth and secure riding experience.
